policy.name: Uttarakhand Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Policy 2023
policy.order_no: MSME Section Notification No. 1145/VII-3-23/04(01)-MSME/2023 dated 09-08-2023 (as cited in the State's own implementation guidelines; ICAI cites 06-09-2023)

zones.A: Category A - hill districts (most remote hill areas)
zones.B: Category B - hill districts / hill areas
zones.D: Category D - developed plains areas (e.g. industrial belts)

zone_lookup: District/block-wise A-D categorisation is an annexure of the MSME Policy 2023 notification (A & B mostly hill districts, C & D mostly plains); annexure not retrieved.

schemes.name: Capital subsidy (assistance on capital goods: workshop building, plant & machinery)
schemes.clause: MSME Policy 2023 - capital subsidy schedule (clause no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY / CONFLICTING. Rates for the first Rs 1 crore of eligible investment (Drishti IAS 15-09-2023: A 50%, B 40%, C 30%, D 'Rs 20 lakh'); higher slabs (Rs 1-5 cr, 5-10 cr, 10-50 cr) get lower marginal rates with an overall maximum of Rs 4 crore (Cat A: Rs 1.5 cr / 2.5 cr / 4 cr by slab per Drishti; publicservicesmap: 20-50%, max Rs 4 crore). ICAI handbook (June 2026) instead shows caps of Rs 50/40/30/20 lakh for A/B/C/D - likely the first-slab cap only. Paid in 2 annual instalments (micro, up to Rs 1 cr) or 5 annual instalments (Rs 1-50 cr). Extra for SC/ST/women: up to Rs 10/15/20 lakh by investment slab; +5%/+10% for priority/most-priority sectors. Applies to units starting commercial production within the policy period; claims via investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in, State Level Authorised Committee.

schemes.name: Interest subsidy on term loan
schemes.clause: MSME Policy 2023 - interest subsidy (clause no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY. ICAI handbook: 4% p.a. for 3 years, max Rs 5/4/3/2 lakh per year in A/B/C/D. publicservicesmap lists 2-4% p.a. (rate may vary by category). Not checked against official text.

schemes.name: Electricity duty reimbursement
schemes.clause: MSME Policy 2023 - electricity duty (clause no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY. 100% reimbursement of electricity duty for 5 years for connected load up to 500 kW (ICAI; publicservicesmap). Not checked against official text.

schemes.name: Quality certification reimbursement
schemes.clause: MSME Policy 2023 - quality certification (clause no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY. 75% up to Rs 1 lakh for ISO/ISI/BIS/ZED/FSSAI etc. (ICAI handbook). ZED awards Rs 75,000 Gold / 50,000 Silver / 25,000 Bronze (ICAI).

other_benefits: DPR assistance 75% of consultant fee up to Rs 1 lakh for new micro enterprises (secondary)
Mandi fee reimbursement 50% up to Rs 5 lakh/yr (A) / Rs 3 lakh/yr (B) for agri/horticulture processing (secondary)
Cluster CFC support up to Rs 5 crore (secondary)
unverifiable: Official policy/guidelines PDF (destinationuttarakhand.uk.gov.in) and all *.uk.gov.in hosts reset connections from this environment after repeated retries; no figure verified against the official text.

Secondary sources conflict on capital subsidy caps (Rs 4 crore overall tiered vs Rs 50/40/30/20 lakh) and notification date (09-08-2023 vs 06-09-2023). valid_to assumed as 5 years from 01-08-2023 per secondary sources ('policy period began 01.08.2023').
